title: Decision tree embedded in a block
statement: For a natural number $d$, a block index $i\in\{0,1,2\}$, and a decision tree on the $3^d$ coordinates with sign inputs and sign outputs, define the corresponding tree on $3^{d+1}$ coordinates by relabelling each queried coordinate through the embedding into block $i$. Its available coordinates are exactly the image of the $3^d$ coordinates in that block.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is one of the three block indices
$T$ is a decision tree on all $3^d$ coordinates with sign inputs and sign outputs
